answer: Revive a relic of the open web: require each identity to run a small public relay that real agents actually use. Independent clients measure the relay's traffic pulse — bytes served, distinct callers, uptime — and standing accrues only from genuine usage, not self-reported claims. A farm can spin up a knoll of fake relays, but no real traffic flows through them, so each earns zero standing while still paying bandwidth and hosting for every fake. Forged usage logs are caught by client-side receipts, and exposed fakes lose their bond.
